notes.title: Major Demo Update & Tiny Teams
notes.notes:
[p]Hi everyone,

We are very excited to announce that Temporal Titans is taking part in the Tiny Teams festival. To celebrate, the demo for the game has been updated with plenty of new content and mechanics. [/p][p][/p][p]The Tiny Teams festival will be running from August 7 to August 14. You can check out all the other great games included in the event by clicking the button below. Thanks to the Yogscast team for organizing the event![/p][p][url="https://store.steampowered.com/curator/423471/sale/tinyteams2025" style="button"]Tiny Teams 2025 Event Page[/url] [/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45108428/0837f71ee7d57c84ef533bcce3da53f0f86315d3.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]If you enjoy the demo, you can support us by wishlisting the game! And if you'd like to support further, you can leave your feedback on the [url="https://steamcommunity.com/app/3037800/discussions/"]Steam Discussions forum[/url]. [/p][p][/p][p][dynamiclink href="steam://openurl/https://store.steampowered.com/app/3037800/Temporal_Titans/?snr=1_5_1100__1100&utm_source=steamwidget"][/dynamiclink][/p][h2][b]Demo Update[/b][/h2][p][/p][h3][b]New Content[/b][/h3][list][*][p]New Zone - Northwoods[/p][/*][*][p]New Boss - Hive Titan[/p][/*][*][p]New Enemy Type - Anchor[/p][/*][*][p]3 New Levels - Canyon, District, Pine Valley (one level per zone)[/p][/*][*][p]Flying Enemies - 3 types of enemies, following their own lane[/p][/*][*][p]New Equipments - Explosive Accelerant, Drive Coils, Melee Capacitors, Ballistic Acid[/p][/*][*][p]New Weapons - Ion beam & Rail Gun[/p][/*][*][p]Tech Upgrades - Global upgrades to turrets and other features[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3][b]Changes[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Each level now has additional lanes for more variety[/p][/*][*][p]Elevation now grants increased attack and damage (Insert high ground joke here)[/p][/*][*][p]Mechs can now have up to 7 equip/weapon slots[/p][/*][*][p]Mechs are now slowed by enemy attacks[/p][/*][*][p]Pilots now have unique stat boots[/p][/*][*][p]Pilots can now be “trained” for a fee to upgrade their stats[/p][/*][*][p]Pilots now get heavily debuffed on failing a mission or injury[/p][/*][*][p]Platforms can now be built on 4 small tiles to "create" a large tile[/p][/*][*][p]Rescue mission type re-added[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3][b]QoL[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Options menu now available[/p][/*][*][p]You can select multiple different language options now[/p][/*][*][p]Loading screens now have helpful tips[/p][/*][*][p]Numerous bug fixes [/p][/*][/list]
